title: QEDBENCH: Quantifying the Alignment Gap in Automated Evaluation of University-Level Mathematical Proofs

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing automated LLM judge mean scores and pass rates to human expert ground truth to quantify systematic grade inflation and false positive rates.
Measuring negative score deltas and false negative rates where AI judges rigidly penalize valid solutions more harshly than human experts (e.g., punishing implicit steps in Complex Analysis).

Calculating the score discrepancy between AI judges and human experts across ten specific mathematical disciplines to identify systemic domain-level misalignment (e.g., leniency in discrete math vs. punitiveness in continuous analysis).

Qualitative and quantitative evaluation of LLM judges assigning overly generous credit to incomplete, truncated, or logically flawed proofs that possess authoritative-sounding LaTeX formatting and correct initial setups.
